Alex — thanks for the context and the usage file. Appreciate the clarity on the two primary asks.

High level we can support a hybrid tranche + usage-floor structure. Proposed bullets to validate before we draft:

1) Term: 24 months (Oct 1, 2026 — Sep 30, 2028) with optional auto-renew for 12 months unless 90 days notice.
2) Structure: Year 1 — reserved tranche covering 70% of projected baseline; usage floor = 60% of that tranche (billing minimum). Year 2 — graduated tranche with a 20% uplift staged at month 13 if early-upsize not exercised.
3) Early-upsize: customer can trigger upsize any time by providing a 14-day notice once usage exceeds 110% of projected trailing 30-day run rate; new reserved capacity priced at year 1 rates if exercised within first 12 months.
4) Co-terming/Proration: if they want to co-term mid-contract with another Sailedrive agreement we can pro-rate remaining months on reserved capacity; will need legal to confirm exact language.

I'll pull Karthik in to align on the pricing schedule for the tiers and Marissa for billing/proration mechanics. If that looks right to you I'll have a draft amendment and pricing worksheet sent by EOD tomorrow.

Best,

Thanks — quick operational notes from billing:

- Proration: for any mid-month upsizes we bill the incremental reserved capacity pro-rated by day and invoice on the normal cycle.
- Billing anchor: committed reserved tranche billed monthly in arrears, usage floor assessment monthly.
- Early-upsize events: we create a new line-item for the upsized reserved capacity; if the customer exercises within 14 days we can backdate to the first of the month if finance needs alignment (requires approval).

Also flagging: if Sailedrive requests co-term across multiple legal entities we need a signed CO-TERM addendum; that typically adds a 5–7 business day legal turnaround.
